before.description_1: C10 Media required content that would seem simpler and more comparable in their project. The page needed to describe the work of the agency using simple language, yet provide visitors with enough information about the service offered, allowing them to judge whether to contact the agency or not.
before.description_2: I structured the page around what visitors need to see first: the offer, the benefit, and the next step. More concise sections, clearer language, and a focused WordPress layout make the agency website easier to understand and more ready for inquiries.

after.description_1: C10 Media is a full-service media agency for cross-media advertising, covering strategy, planning and media buying across channels such as out-of-home, digital, television, radio, cinema and print. The website needed to make that broad offer understandable without reducing it to a generic agency proposition.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around media solutions, cases and a clear introduction to C10 Media’s strategic approach. Visitors can explore specific advertising formats, review previous campaigns and move into a consultation while the cross-media proposition stays consistent across the site.

before.description_1: Administratiegids needed to make comparing financial services easier for entrepreneurs who want practical guidance instead of technical explanations. Visitors had to understand whether a service matched their situation, what kind of support was available, and how they could ask a question.
before.description_2: The website was designed to feel clear, calm, and informative without becoming too heavy. It presents comparison content in a structured way, so visitors can move naturally from orientation to interest. The design supports quick understanding while still leaving room for deeper information when needed.

after.description_1: Administratiegids helps entrepreneurs orient themselves within bookkeeping and administrative services instead of starting from technical accounting terminology. The website needed to make provider comparison, practical guidance and requesting information feel straightforward.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around clear comparison and guidance content, with deeper information available when visitors need it. The structure supports quick orientation first and keeps quote or contact actions close to the point where an entrepreneur is ready to compare providers.

before.description_1: The most crucial issue faced by Miamicarwash was how to ensure the offer could be communicated in just a few seconds. The company had to give details about what their products were, their target market, and the reason why reaching out to them would be good for people.
before.description_2: Through the transformation of automotive stories into a well-structured story with a good hook and appropriate service details, the WordPress design ensures that all the information is made accessible and comprehensible not only from a desktop computer but also through the use of a smartphone. There will be no doubts anymore.

after.description_1: Miami Carwash combines premium hand washing with detailing services such as polishing, interior cleaning, steaming, coatings, Wachol treatment and brake-caliper painting at two locations in The Hague. The website needed to present those services clearly while keeping a visit or booking action immediately accessible.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the service categories, locations and direct planning options. Visitors can quickly understand what is available, find the nearest location and move toward a wash or tailored quotation without having to navigate through general automotive content.

before.description_1: The Need for Transport Page in the Case of Taxi Centrale Rijswijk became necessary as the tourists would need to get an understanding of the type of proposal they had to make contact with the company. There was some structure missing in the narrative presented, besides there was too much use of generalized statements.
before.description_2: It has been designed on the basis of sections which are easier to comprehend and also provide good-quality English language writing material for use in WordPress blocks. It provides an overview of the effort involved and its importance, and what actions can be taken by the visitors.

after.description_1: Taxi Centrale Rijswijk is a transport website built around practical passenger needs such as local taxi journeys, airport transfers and direct booking. The project needed clear service information, trust and a short route from checking the offer to arranging a ride.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress page around the main transport services and the booking decision. Pricing or journey context sits close to clear contact and reservation actions, while the responsive layout keeps the same direct path available for visitors using the site on the move.

before.description_1: When it comes to the Vanbachfinance example, it should be noted that the main challenge was to present the offer in such a way that the reader would understand its essence within only two seconds. The most crucial part was to highlight its features, for whom it was intended, and why people need to contact the company.
before.description_2: The finance article was streamlined to make it simpler, starting with the introduction, services sections, and ensuring that relevant details were placed near the right actions. The design on the WordPress platform allows for quick scans of the site from either desktop or mobile devices, helping people determine whether or not they need to contact Vanbachfinance.

after.description_1: Van Bach Finance provides financial and tax services for entrepreneurs, including bookkeeping, VAT and income-tax returns, annual accounts, payroll administration and business advice. The website needed to explain those services and package options clearly enough for businesses to understand what they can outsource.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around service groups, transparent pricing and the route to an introductory appointment. Visitors can compare bookkeeping and advisory support, see what is included for different business forms and move toward contact with practical expectations already set.

before.description_1: Werken bij Alpina Drive needed more focused content, because the key recruitment information was not immediately clear. The page needed a stronger introduction, smoother transitions between sections, and straightforward wording that explains the offer before visitors decide to make contact.
before.description_2: I reorganised the page with clearer formatting, stronger content sections, and a more logical flow from start to finish. The recruitment story now avoids unnecessary detail, helps visitors compare the opportunity more easily, and keeps the WordPress design consistent across different screen sizes.

after.description_1: Werken bij Alpina Drive is a recruitment-focused website that turns employer information and open roles into a dedicated candidate journey. The challenge was to give job seekers enough context about the organisation and opportunities before asking them to apply.
after.description_2: I organised the WordPress experience around vacancy discovery, employer information and application actions. Clear content sections help candidates understand the workplace and role options first, while the responsive design keeps the application route easy to use on mobile.

before.description_1: The primary task for SoDrive Académie involved communicating its educational offer clearly within a few seconds. The webpage had to communicate what services were offered, who they were intended for, and why one should get in touch. This would make the communication more precise.
before.description_2: The education story was then simplified to have an attention-grabbing introduction, clearly outlined services with practical information closer to where action is needed. The WordPress design allows fast scanning from both desktop and mobile devices, making it easier for the website visitor to know what is being offered by SoDrive Academie. Contact was essential.

after.description_1: SoDrive Academie trains new driving instructors through flexible e-learning and classroom programmes, with clear phases, entry requirements, prices, start dates and available places. The website needed to turn that detailed training information into a decision path prospective students can follow.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around the instructor-training programme, study options, pricing and live start dates. Visitors can understand the training phases, compare learning formats and move directly into registration, while supporting information about guidance and starting a driving-school career remains connected to the main route.

before.description_1: Furkan Educatie needed an education page that makes the offer understandable from the first screen. Visitors had to see what is being offered, who it is for and why they should continue reading or get in touch.
before.description_2: I rewrote the content into clearer sections with a stronger flow from introduction to action. The WordPress page now explains the education offer in plain language, supports quick scanning and helps visitors move towards contact with more confidence.

after.description_1: Furkan Educatie Centrum is a nonprofit education and community organisation in The Hague that provides Islamic religious education alongside social, sports and community activities. The website needed to explain both the educational offer and the organisation’s broader social role while keeping registration practical.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around lessons, organisation information, activities and registration. Parents and participants can quickly see what the centre offers, understand its locations and background and move toward enrolment or contact without the community information obscuring the education journey.
